defect: v1 matcher split each 買い条件 at '／' and treated ANY piece as a match (e.g. フィレンツェファイア: a mare at ダート1200m matched 「ダート1200m以下／母が米国型／牡馬」). Reported by an external review on 2026-11-18 and reproduced.
fix: v2 matcher (research/kametani/sire_rules_v2.json, hand-structured: alternatives OR, conditions AND; unknown never counts as match; JRA-only scenes NOT_LOCAL).
evaluation_rule: C7 counts only predictions whose kametani profile is KM-LOCAL-KAMETANI-PEDIGREE-EVIDENCE-v2*; all v1 records are excluded, not re-labelled. Stages and decision rule of C7 unchanged; its race count restarts from the first v2 prediction.
known_limit: damsire class is known for only ~15% of runners (only damsires with their own dictionary entry), so most damsire-conditioned scenes stay UNKNOWN.
